sentences.text_target: Tom lives in a small apartment on the second floor.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm lɪvz ɪn ə smɔːl əˈpɑːtmənt ɒn ðə ˈsɛkənd flɔː/
sentences.text_native: Tom vit dans un petit appartement au deuxième étage.

sentences.text_target: He wakes up when the alarm clock sounds.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː weɪks ʌp wɛn ði əˈlɑːm klɒk saʊndz/
sentences.text_native: Il se réveille quand le réveil sonne.

sentences.text_target: He gets out of bed and puts his feet on the cold floor.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː gɛts aʊt ɒv bɛd ænd pʊts hɪz fiːt ɒn ðə kəʊld flɔː/
sentences.text_native: Il sort du lit et pose ses pieds sur le sol froid.

sentences.text_target: He walks out of the bedroom and goes down the stairs.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːks aʊt ɒv ðə ˈbɛdruːm ænd gəʊz daʊn ðə stɛəz/
sentences.text_native: Il sort de la chambre et descend les escaliers.

sentences.text_target: He enters the living room and looks at the big window.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈɛntəz ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ruːm ænd lʊks æt ðə bɪg ˈwɪndəʊ/
sentences.text_native: Il entre dans le salon et regarde la grande fenêtre.

sentences.text_target: The weather outside is very sunny today.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɛðə ˈaʊtsaɪd ɪz ˈvɛri ˈsʌni təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il fait très beau dehors aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: There is a green sofa and a small wooden table near the wall.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə griːn ˈsəʊfə ænd ə smɔːl ˈwʊdən ˈteɪbl nɪə ðə wɔːl/
sentences.text_native: Il y a un canapé vert et une petite table en bois près du mur.

sentences.text_target: A tall lamp stands behind the sofa.
sentences.phonetic: /ə tɔːl læmp stændz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈsəʊfə/
sentences.text_native: Un grand lampadaire se dresse derrière le canapé.

sentences.text_target: He sees many interesting books on the wooden shelf.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː siːz ˈmɛni ˈɪntrɪstɪŋ bʊks ɒn ðə ˈwʊdən ʃɛlf/
sentences.text_native: Il voit de nombreux livres intéressants sur l'étagère en bois.

sentences.text_target: Next to the shelf, his computer is on the clean desk.
sentences.phonetic: /nɛkst tuː ðə ʃɛlf, hɪz kəmˈpjuːtə ɪz ɒn ðə kliːn dɛsk/
sentences.text_native: À côté de l'étagère, son ordinateur est posé sur le bureau propre.

sentences.text_target: He leaves some paper and a pen beside the computer.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː liːvz sʌm ˈpeɪpər ænd ə pɛn bɪˈsaɪd ðə kəmˈpjuːtə/
sentences.text_native: Il laisse du papier et un stylo à côté de l'ordinateur.

sentences.text_target: Then he walks into the modern kitchen to make breakfast.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hiː wɔːks ˈɪntuː ðə ˈmɒdən ˈkɪtʃɪn tuː meɪk ˈbrɛkfəst/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il va dans la cuisine moderne pour préparer le petit-déjeuner.

sentences.text_target: He opens the fridge and takes out the milk and butter.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈəʊpənz ðə frɪdʒ ænd teɪks aʊt ðə mɪlk ænd ˈbʌtə/
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre le réfrigérateur et sort le lait et le beurre.

sentences.text_target: He uses a sharp knife to cut some fresh bread.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈjuːzɪz ə ʃɑːp naɪf tuː kʌt sʌm frɛʃ brɛd/
sentences.text_native: Il utilise un couteau bien aiguisé pour couper du pain frais.

sentences.text_target: He puts the bread on a white plate.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pʊts ðə brɛd ɒn ə waɪt pleɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il met le pain sur une assiette blanche.

sentences.text_target: The coffee maker prepares a hot cup of coffee quickly.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɒfi ˈmeɪkə prɪˈpɛəz ə hɒt kʌp ɒv ˈkɒfi ˈkwɪkli/
sentences.text_native: La cafetière prépare rapidement une tasse de café chaud.

sentences.text_target: He sits on a comfortable chair and eats his meal.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː sɪts ɒn ə ˈkʌmfətəbl tʃɛər ænd iːts hɪz miːl/
sentences.text_native: Il s'assoit sur une chaise confortable et prend son repas.

sentences.text_target: When he finishes eating, he goes to the bathroom.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛn hiː ˈfɪnɪʃɪz ˈiːtɪŋ, hiː gəʊz tuː ðə ˈbɑːθruːm/
sentences.text_native: Quand il a fini de manger, il va dans la salle de bains.

sentences.text_target: He takes a quick shower with warm water and nice soap.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː teɪks ə kwɪk ˈʃaʊə wɪð wɔːm ˈwɔːtər ænd naɪs səʊp/
sentences.text_native: Il prend une douche rapide avec de l'eau tiède et du bon savon.

sentences.text_target: He dries his face and body with a soft towel.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː draɪz hɪz feɪs ænd ˈbɒdi wɪð ə sɒft ˈtaʊəl/
sentences.text_native: Il s'essuie le visage et le corps avec une serviette douce.

sentences.text_target: He looks in the mirror and brushes his short hair.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː lʊks ɪn ðə ˈmɪrər ænd ˈbrʌʃɪz hɪz ʃɔːt hɛə/
sentences.text_native: Il se regarde dans le miroir et se brosse les cheveux courts.

sentences.text_target: Then he returns to the bedroom to open his large wardrobe.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hiː rɪˈtɜːnz tuː ðə ˈbɛdruːm tuː ˈəʊpən hɪz lɑːrdʒ ˈwɔːdrəʊb/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il retourne dans la chambre pour ouvrir sa grande armoire.

sentences.text_target: He chooses a clean blue shirt and dark pants.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈtʃuːzɪz ə kliːn bluː ʃɜːt ænd dɑːk pænts/
sentences.text_native: Il choisit une chemise bleue propre et un pantalon foncé.

sentences.text_target: He puts on his shoes and wears his warm winter jacket.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pʊts ɒn hɪz ʃuːz ænd wɛəz hɪz wɔːm ˈwɪntə ˈdʒækɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il met ses chaussures et enfile sa veste d'hiver bien chaude.

sentences.text_target: He checks the time on the clock on the wall.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː tʃɛks ðə taɪm ɒn ðə klɒk ɒn ðə wɔːl/
sentences.text_native: Il regarde l'heure sur l'horloge au mur.

sentences.text_target: He takes his phone, his keys, and a black umbrella.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː teɪks hɪz fəʊn, hɪz kiːz, ænd ə blæk ʌmˈbrɛlə/
sentences.text_native: Il prend son téléphone, ses clés et un parapluie noir.

sentences.text_target: He walks to the front door and turns the metal lock.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːks tuː ðə frʌnt dɔːr ænd tɜːnz ðə ˈmɛtl lɒk/
sentences.text_native: Il marche jusqu'à la porte d'entrée et tourne la serrure.

sentences.text_target: He steps outside onto the busy street.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː stɛps ˈaʊtsaɪd ˈɒntuː ðə ˈbɪzi striːt/
sentences.text_native: Il sort dans la rue animée.

sentences.text_target: He locks the heavy door carefully behind him.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː lɒks ðə ˈhɛvi dɔː ˈkɛəfʊli bɪˈhaɪnd hɪm/
sentences.text_native: Il ferme soigneusement la lourde porte derrière lui.

sentences.text_target: He walks quickly to the corner to catch the morning bus.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː wɔːks ˈkwɪkli tuː ðə ˈkɔːnə tuː kætʃ ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ bʌs/
sentences.text_native: Il marche d'un pas vif vers le coin de la rue pour prendre le bus du matin.
